items.deadline_text: Within 180 days of the enactment of this section

items.duty_text: Mail a certified copy of this local law by registered or certified mail to the New York state commissioner of taxation and finance and file a certified copy of this local law with the New York state tax commission, the city clerk, the secretary of state and the New York state comptroller.
items.deadline_text: Within five days of the enactment of this local law

items.duty_text: Divide New York City into at least twenty commercial waste zones.
items.deadline_text: no later than 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section

items.duty_text: Issue requests for proposals to conduct commercial waste removal in commercial waste zones.
items.deadline_text: no later than one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section

items.duty_text: Complete the first detailed, comprehensive citywide multi-season study of the city’s residential and institutional waste streams to determine the composition of the waste stream by type of material.
Complete the second detailed, comprehensive citywide multi-season study of the city’s residential and institutional waste streams to determine the composition of the waste stream by type of material.
Complete the third detailed, comprehensive citywide multi-season study of the city’s residential and institutional waste streams to determine the composition of the waste stream by type of material.
Notify the owner by certified mail, return receipt requested, when the owner’s name and address are located on and legible on an unlawfully placed bin.
Prominently post information indicating how to contact the small business advocate on the agency’s website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Develop and submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a plan to increase enforcement of section 16-118(4) of the administrative code, including the specified locations, staffing, violation data, enforcement steps, and implementation date.
Make available on the department’s website a downloadable sample sign satisfying the specified requirements.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Conduct outreach and education about the requirements of § 16-401, in consultation with other city agencies, using multiple languages and accessibility best practices.
Provide information about available compostable single-use beverage splash sticks, beverage stirrers and beverage straws on the department’s website.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Establish public education programs regarding the commercial waste zone system.
Provide an awardee adequate notice of whether the department intends to renew an agreement before the agreement expires.
items.deadline_text: prior to the expiration of any agreement entered into pursuant to this section

items.duty_text: Ensure that agreements with awardees include the statutory requirements governing designated-carter service, rates, customer agreements, organic-waste collection, billing, reporting, plans, training, and compliance.
Waive specified sanitation-related civil penalties.
Issue warning notices for specified second or third sanitation offenses.
Issue warning notices for specified second or third yard-waste offenses.
Issue warning notices for specified second or third signage offenses.
Issue warning notices for specified second or third operator offenses.
Issue a warning notice for a first violation involving unauthorized commercial-establishment signage, subject to the statutory exception.

Assist the Department of Parks and Recreation in removing fallen tree limbs, branches and vegetation that obstruct sidewalks, streets and parking spaces within 72 hours of discovery after inclement weather, subject to the Department of Sanitation’s core duties.
items.deadline_text: within 72 hours of discovery after inclement weather

items.duty_text: Implement a program testing the mechanical reliability and operational feasibility of alternative-fuel street-sweeping vehicles, including a pilot project in at least four sanitation districts.
Collect and analyze data to develop initiatives for and assess the feasibility of incorporating new alternative-fuel sanitation vehicles and technology into its fleet.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Refrain from issuing a violation when solid waste or recyclable material is placed out after 6:00 a.m. but before collection occurs, under the specified conditions.

Establish an online application for community gardens to request organic waste collection, post it on the department’s website, make it available in all designated citywide languages, permit submission by authorized persons, and allow requests for weekly, biweekly, or monthly collection.
Begin collecting organic waste from community gardens that submitted a request through the application.
Make the rotation-tow lists available for public inspection at the department.

observation.label: Awaiting an evidence detector
observation.note: No evidence detector for “data publication” yet.

items.duty_text: Establish and maintain a stationary on-street container program requiring covered residential buildings to place residential waste in department-supplied stationary on-street containers.
Deliver official waste containers at no cost to eligible residential building owners, subject to appropriations.
Establish a program to reimburse eligible residential building owners for official waste containers purchased by the owners, subject to appropriations.
Establish and implement a pilot program for at least 6 months for the use of power washing machines to clean and remove odors and spills from sidewalks located in a commercial corridor.
Commence the pilot program upon selection of suitable locations, no later than April 1, 2026.
items.deadline_text: upon the selection of suitable locations, but no later than April 1, 2026

items.duty_text: Consult with the Department of Environmental Protection before choosing locations for the pilot program.
